name: dirty-reader-cost-and-coverage
body: Two limits on the dirty reader. (1) It reads every durable rel table and filters endpoints in memory (the same shape `node_files_from_db` uses), so a save costs O(all authored edges); upgrade to a per-relation `WHERE a.fqn IN … OR b.fqn IN …` probe if the durable edge set grows large enough for save latency to matter. (2) It has no unit/int test of its own — a database reader is real I/O, so it is e2e by definition, and its declared scope was the one file — so its behaviour is pinned by phase-2 tasks 4/10/15 and shares the reconstruction the existing `node_files_from_db` e2e cases exercise; give it a dedicated case if it grows a selection beyond `updated = 1` plus the ledger filter.
